title: Leo Baeck Fellowship Programme
summary: Grants for doctoral students researching German-Jewish history and culture. Includes a 1-year stipend, research cost allowance, workshops, and networking opportunities.

subject_areas.notes: Projects on German-Jewish Studies on history and culture, including literature, philosophy, history, culture studies

nationality.notes: It is open to doctoral candidates of any nationality

residence.notes: All fellows remain at their home institutions

mandatory.text: latest higher education degree must be issued no earlier than February 2022
research project focussing on German-Jewish history and culture

funding.description: stipend of 1,650 EUR per month together with a research cost allowance of 100 EUR. If necessary, a health insurance allowance of up to 100 EUR will also be included. In addition, allowances for fellows with children or for a (part-time) stay abroad are paid.

application_rounds.notes: You may find current application deadlines on the Studienstiftung website.

steps.text: Please find the application forms and further information on the application procedure on the external website.

sources.title: German National Academic Foundation: Leo Baeck Fellowship Programme - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme supports doctoral students carrying out research, and candidates preparing and submitting dissertations to universities in Germany can apply for extensions.
